in_hebrew.name: גרבאש
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'gavar' meaning 'to be heavy' or 'to serve'. The name Gervais is derived from the Old French 'Gervais' meaning 'servant of Ger', which is a shortened form of the name Gaugeric or Gerard.

in_greek.name: Γερβάσιος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek 'geranos' meaning 'workman' or 'servant'. The name Gervais is derived from the Latin 'Gervasius', which is a Latinized form of the Old French name.

in_latin.name: Gervasius
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin 'gerare' meaning 'to serve'. The name Gervais is derived from the Latin 'Gervasius', which is a Latinized form of the Old French name.
